name: hatebookkeeping
description: Finance OS for Axilogy and Naton

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hbk/shared && npm run build --workspace @naton/ui && npm run build --workspace @hbk/server && npm run build --workspace @hbk/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @hbk/shared && npm run build --workspace @naton/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,ui,server,web -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:ui" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
